## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally (typecheck, lint, unit tests, build)
- [ ] New behaviour is covered by a test that fails without the change
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and focus order still work
- [ ] Checked in both light and dark themes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or customer data in the diff
- [ ] Docs / README updated if the setup or contract changed
